title: AR/VR Developer
description: Create immersive spatial computing experiences, virtual reality simulations, and augmented reality apps using Unity, Unreal Engine, OpenXR, and Apple visionOS.

goal.objective: Engineer cutting-edge spatial computing applications, 3D interaction mechanics, and immersive mixed-reality experiences for headsets and mobile devices.
career_pillars: OpenXR & Headset SDKs (Meta Quest, Vision Pro)

learn.summary: Master real-time 3D mathematics (quaternions, vectors), Unity XR Interaction Toolkit, OpenXR standard, hand-tracking mechanics, spatial audio, and performance optimization.
key_competencies: Unity XR Interaction Toolkit & AR Foundation
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with 3D math and coordinates

capstone_projects.title: Spatial Mixed-Reality Medical Training Simulator
capstone_projects.description: Build an interactive VR surgical training tool featuring precise hand tracking, grab physics, and spatial audio feedback.

interview_focus: Minimizing VR Motion Sickness (Latency & Refresh Rates)
Forward Rendering vs Deferred Rendering in VR
Spatial Anchors & Plane Detection Mechanics in AR

tree.name: Foundational Skills for XR Development
tree.description: Master C# programming, Unity engine fundamentals, 3D graphics concepts, and core XR design principles to build a strong base for immersive applications.

resources.title: Unity Course for Beginners – Learn Game Development
Project-Based Augmented Reality Course with Unity (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: C# Programming for Unity
children.description: Develop robust gameplay systems using C# with Unity, covering MonoBehaviours, events, delegates, coroutines, ScriptableObjects, state machines, and asynchronous programming patterns.

resources.title: Unity C# Survival Guide for Absolute Beginners

children.name: Unity Engine Core Concepts
children.description: Deep dive into Unity's architecture including GameObjects, Components, Prefabs, Scene Management, Physics, Lighting, Animation, Scripting Lifecycle, Input Systems, and UI Systems (Canvas, UGUI).

resources.title: Unity Game Development Course For Beginners (Learn to Code a 3D Game)

children.name: Software Architecture & Design Patterns in Unity
children.description: Apply common software design principles (SOLID) and architectural patterns (MVC, MVVM, Dependency Injection, Service Locators, State Machines) to create scalable, maintainable, and robust Unity projects for XR.

resources.title: Unity Design Patterns - The BEST way to structure code!
SOLID Principles - Making your Unity C# Code Cleaner

children.name: 3D Graphics & Linear Algebra for Games
children.description: Understand basic 3D math (vectors, matrices, quaternions), coordinate systems, transformations, camera projections, rendering pipelines (SRP/URP/HDRP basics), and fundamental graphics concepts essential for XR development.

resources.title: 3D Math Primer for Graphics and Game Development
Linear Algebra for Game Development - Full Course
3D Graphics & Rendering Explained (URP, HDRP, PBR & more!)

children.name: XR Design Principles & Spatial UX
children.description: Learn core principles of designing for XR: comfort, presence, immersion, spatial UI/UX patterns, locomotion mechanics, interaction models, affordances, wayfinding, and mitigating motion sickness and simulator sickness.

resources.title: Roadmap to Reality | XR Design Principles

tree.name: Core AR/VR Development
tree.description: Implement foundational AR and VR experiences using Unity's XR packages, including environmental tracking, spatial interactions, locomotion systems, and platform-specific considerations.

resources.title: Learn VR Development in 3 Hours (Valem Tutorials)

children.name: AR Foundation & Mobile AR
children.description: Develop robust mobile AR applications with Unity AR Foundation, covering plane detection, image/object tracking, face tracking, cloud anchors, light estimation, session management, and platform integration (ARKit/ARCore specific features).

resources.title: Building AR Apps with Unity AR Foundation Course
Unity AR Foundation Tutorial For Beginners

children.name: VR Interaction Toolkit & Locomotion
children.description: Implement diverse VR interactions using Unity's XR Interaction Toolkit: direct and indirect interaction, grab mechanics, UI interaction, haptic feedback, and various locomotion systems (teleportation, smooth locomotion, snap turning, continuous turning).

resources.title: Unity Learn: Introduction to the XR Interaction Toolkit
Unity XR Interaction Toolkit - Hand Presence, Continuous Movement & Turning, Grabbing
XR Interaction Toolkit - Teleportation - Unity VR Tutorial

children.name: Spatial Audio & Audio Design for XR
children.description: Implement immersive audio environments using Unity's audio system, spatializers (HRTF), audio zones, sound occlusion, and dynamic audio effects to enhance presence and user experience in AR/VR.

resources.title: VR Spatial Audio with Unity (Valem Tutorials)

children.name: Project: Building Your First XR Application
children.description: Apply learned fundamentals to create a basic AR or VR scene, incorporating simple interactions, environmental setup, and testing on a device emulator or real hardware to solidify core concepts.

resources.title: Make an AR App in 15 Minutes (immersive insiders)
VR Dev Project: Simple Grabbing with XR Interaction Toolkit

children.name: XR Platform Integration (OpenXR, Meta, etc.)
children.description: Understand and integrate with major XR platforms and APIs using OpenXR, Meta Quest SDK, SteamVR, or other relevant device-specific SDKs for advanced features, performance optimization, and broader device compatibility.

resources.title: Getting Started with OpenXR in Unity
Meta Quest 2 (Oculus) Development for Beginners - Learn How To Make VR Games!

children.name: Advanced XR Features
children.description: Explore and implement advanced immersive functionalities such as hand tracking, eye tracking, passthrough AR, mixed reality blending, persistent anchors, body tracking, and multiplayer XR experiences using relevant SDKs and Unity services.

resources.title: Build a Hand Tracking System in VR (Unity, Meta Quest 2)

tree.name: Production Readiness: Performance & Assets
tree.description: Optimize XR applications for performance, manage 3D assets efficiently, and prepare professional-grade immersive demos, ensuring high fidelity and smooth user experiences.

resources.title: Performance Best Practices for XR | Unite Copenhagen 2019
Unreal Fest Europe 2023 - Optimizing Virtual Reality Experiences with Unreal Engine

children.name: XR Performance Optimization
children.description: Implement comprehensive strategies to achieve high frame rates and maintain user comfort in XR, covering draw call reduction, batching, occlusion culling, LODs, texture compression, lighting optimization, and efficient garbage collection.

resources.title: Unity VR Performance: Advanced Tips & Tricks
Optimizing VR performance with Unity | Unity VR Dev Log

children.name: Profiling & Debugging XR Applications
children.description: Utilize Unity Profiler, Frame Debugger, Memory Profiler, XR diagnostic tools, and platform-specific debuggers to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, visual glitches, and runtime errors in immersive applications.

resources.title: Unity Performance Optimization (Unity Profiler basics and advanced)
Unity Performance Optimization Tutorial - How to Optimize Your Game

children.name: 3D Asset Pipeline & Management
children.description: Manage 3D models, textures, and animations effectively for XR. Understand import settings, mesh optimization, poly count reduction, PBR materials, texture atlasing, skeletal animation, and asset bundling strategies for various platforms.

resources.title: Everything you Need to Know about PBR in Unity
Unity 3D Game Performance Optimization for beginners in Unity 2021 | The ULTIMATE GUIDE

children.name: Shader Development & Visual Effects (URP/HDRP)
children.description: Craft custom shaders using Unity's Shader Graph or HLSL, focusing on optimized rendering for XR, creating visual effects, and integrating with Universal Render Pipeline (URP) and High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP).

resources.title: Unity Learn: Introduction to Shader Graph
Introduction to Unity Shader Graph | URP

children.name: WebXR Development (Optional Path)
children.description: Explore browser-based immersive experiences using WebXR, Three.js, Babylon.js, or A-Frame, understanding device API access, progressive enhancement for web-based AR/VR, and deployment to web servers.

resources.title: Learn WebXR - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Capstone Project: Professional XR Demo
children.description: Develop a polished AR product viewer, VR training simulation, or an interactive mixed reality experience from concept to completion. Focus on robust interactions, performance optimization, and professional presentation suitable for a portfolio.

resources.title: Unity VR Tutorial for Beginners - Learn VR Development

tree.name: Deployment & Professional Practice
tree.description: Learn how to rigorously test, debug, and deploy XR applications across various platforms, ensuring a high-quality user experience and successful distribution to app stores or clients.

resources.title: How to Publish Android App on Play Store - Step by Step | Hindi
Flutter App Deployment to Play Store & App Store | How to publish Flutter app

children.name: Immersive Usability & QA Testing
children.description: Conduct thorough usability and quality assurance testing for XR, focusing on comfort, interaction clarity, onboarding effectiveness, motion sickness mitigation, accessibility, and identifying session-breaking bugs through user studies and technical QA.

children.name: Device Builds & Store Submission
children.description: Configure and create release builds for target platforms (Android, iOS, Meta Quest, PCVR, etc.), manage signing keys, handle runtime permissions, prepare store listings (descriptions, screenshots, trailers), and navigate the submission and review processes for major app stores.

resources.title: How to Publish Your Android App to Google Play Store - Full Tutorial

children.name: Version Control & Collaboration
children.description: Utilize Git and Git LFS for efficient version control, manage large binary assets common in game development, and implement collaborative workflows for team-based XR development projects, including branching and merging strategies.

resources.title: Git & GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
Git LFS Crash Course (Manage Large Files in Git)
